The '''Dail sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], located near [[Bajic sector/Legends|Bajic sector]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Dail included [[Danadine]], [[Friijillis]], and [[Lesu]].
